scope: Additive Dragon Duke Flame Blower L1-18 damage, direction and Rocket Backpack interaction audit.
game_version: Official June and August 2026 interaction changes; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: THE ANIME FURY UPDATE IS HERE
facts: Equipment activation order is fixed by Equipment identity rather than slot.
Flame Blower activates before Rocket Backpack regardless of slot arrangement.
sources.limitations: No 10 ms subphase, direction vector, flame geometry, duration or damage timing is specified.

sources.title: July Balance Update
facts: The June direction change caused Rocket Backpack to sometimes fail, so Flame Blower temporarily reverted to pushing in Rocket Backpack's direction.
sources.limitations: This intermediate behavior is superseded by the August 2026 fix.

sources.title: August Update
facts: Flame Blower now fires in the direction Dragon Duke is facing.
Rocket Backpack dash flame omissions and premature stops were fixed, and the Duke finishes the dash before being defeated.
sources.limitations: No coordinate definition of facing, frame at which facing is sampled, dash path or flame hit ordering is given.

sources.title: Flame Blower — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated table matches pinned Dragon Duke HP bonus 500-3100 and ore costs.
sources.limitations: No active damage, recovery, directional hitbox or activation timing values are published.

sources.title: Pinned Flame Blower Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned ability label is 12 tile damage radius, L1-18 damage is 1300-2700 and HP recovery increase is 150-1500.
sources.limitations: The pinned L15 damage 2700 exceeds L16/L17 damage 2250; no consulted source resolves this anomaly or defines radius shape, duration, hit phase or target eligibility.

derivations.result: Current official ordering is Flame Blower before Rocket Backpack; after the August fix Flame Blower fires in the Duke's facing direction
derivations.method: Order June, July and August primary notices chronologically, retain pinned numeric labels as historical catalogue data, and do not infer geometry or timing.

rejected_inferences.rule: Activate Rocket Backpack first when its UI slot precedes Flame Blower
rejected_inferences.reason: June 2026 release explicitly fixes order by Equipment identity.

rejected_inferences.rule: Keep July's Rocket Backpack direction as the current rule
rejected_inferences.reason: The July post calls it temporary; August states Flame Blower now fires in Duke facing direction.

rejected_inferences.rule: Correct pinned L15 damage 2700 to a monotone progression
rejected_inferences.reason: No primary or dated numeric source identifies the correct L15 value; preserve the anomaly and do not use it in combat.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat 12 tiles as a circular area around Dragon Duke
rejected_inferences.reason: The official effect is directional, while the raw radius label supplies no cone, beam, origin or target geometry.

items: current ability damage and recovery values, especially anomalous L15 damage
direction vector and facing sample tick
flame origin, shape, length/radius, affected targets, travel and hit order
activation and Rocket Backpack subphase ordering on fixed 10 ms ticks
recovery timing, Duke death/dash and Pet interaction
Viewer flames and direction, snapshot, replay and RL loadout state

conclusion: Flame Blower L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official sources establish identity-based activation before Rocket Backpack and, after August 2026, firing in Dragon Duke's facing direction. Pinned damage has an unresolved L15 anomaly; current damage, directional geometry and fixed-tick hit/order contracts are absent. No Equipment Core actor is enabled.
